title: LL-979 Yub-Yub Canopy Explorer
description: An Ewok expedition cruiser in the language of 1978 Classic Space: swept grey wings, blue hull, amber glazing and printed planet insignia. An orange hood surrounds the cheeky twin-window face; round listening ears are navigation dishes. Timber engine jackets, woven photovoltaic wings, paw landing pads and an open acorn-powered cargo deck make forest technology part of the spacecraft.
